author: Zman217
quote: GTA 6 gave me a world I wanted to explore and a story I couldn’t get invested in. The graphics are incredible, but the bland characters, scattered plot, and limited gameplay made it feel like a watered down GTA game overall. Playing at 30 FPS with glitches, repeated crashes, and no online at launch made it feel unfinished. Hopefully better on PC or next gen consoles, but for now, I was more impressed by what I could see than by what I could do.
